Persons Collection[Ring[Json[Person]]]
  model/spec.go:8:6 · package example.com/model · spec form

Step  Layer       Kind      Effect
1     Person      subject   struct model: 4 fields, 4 tags
2     Json        element   streaming codec with no reflection, driven by the subject's json tags
3     Ring        storage   fixed-capacity circular buffer, so a long-running producer cannot grow memory without bound
4     Collection  refining  query, projection and sort methods built from the subject's fields

3     Ring        Sized, Ordered, Streamable, Bounded  —      Sized, Ordered, Structured, Encodable, Streamable, Bounded
4     Collection  —                                    —      Sized, Ordered, Structured, Encodable, Streamable, Bounded
